payload.comment: Ingestion stage is structurally sound. Dataset manifest and run manifest are internally consistent: split sizes (train=89996, val=10004, test=7180) match the official PathMNIST partition, subsampled=false, 9 classes / 3 channels, CC BY 4.0 license, and all integrity hashes (archive MD5, per-split index SHA-256, code SHA-256) are present. No deterministic findings were raised and no artifacts were omitted. One reproducibility gap: llm_model_digest is null for the 'qwen3.8' Ollama model. Without a pinned digest the exact LLM weights used in downstream stages cannot be verified, weakening end-to-end reproducibility. This does not block ingestion but should be resolved before any stage that invokes the LLM. The test-domain note (CRC-VAL-HE-7K from a different clinical center) is correctly documented and is a known PathMNIST characteristic; it should be carried forward into any evaluation reporting. All package versions, Python version, and platform string are recorded. Proceed to the next stage.
llm_issues: llm_model_digest is null for model 'qwen3.8' (ollama); exact model weights are not pinned, creating a reproducibility gap for any downstream LLM-dependent stage

Test split originates from a different clinical center (CRC-VAL-HE-7K); this domain shift is documented but must be explicitly acknowledged in all downstream evaluation and reporting to avoid over-interpretation of test metrics
